positive_controls.argument: Current accessible rationale and configuration-linked knowledge supply the substantive content needed by proportionate documentation and governance.
Unique recoverable configuration and baseline status give the evidence chain a determinate subject.
Reconciliation with the built, tested and operated system establishes or limits the applicability of the retained evidence.
Proportionate change analysis identifies what must be updated or reauthorized while preserving unaffected evidence.
A versioned testable contract and two-sided ownership supply substantive interface content for the evidence chain.
A feasible method, stated article and clear criterion supply meaningful verification content for the governance record.
Relevant multi-level results supply the substantive interaction evidence and expose limits of lower-level records.
Accurate queryable links implement the needed relation between obligation, configuration and evidence at justified upkeep cost.
Explicit assumptions, defeaters and evidence reasoning supply the substantive assurance explanation that document volume cannot provide.
One problem identity, configuration scope and authorized disposition supply the concrete exception provenance required by the evidence chain.
Scoped data authority, versioning and reality reconciliation provide concrete means to maintain trustworthy evidence and governed access.
Fresh identified outputs and explicit coverage limits make required evidence current while allowing justified reuse and proportionate manual judgment.
